lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm Kim Minsu from the HR department.
lines.en: Hello. I'm Lee Jieun, deputy manager in Sales.

lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me about your career so far?
lines.learner: 사원을 시작으로 대리를 거쳐 차장을 맡았습니다.
lines.en: I started as a staff member, went through assistant manager, and took on deputy manager.
lines.roman: sawoneul sijageuro daerireul geochyeo chajangeul matatseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Which team were you in at first?
lines.en: At first, I was a customer service agent.
Yes, I led the team and got promoted quickly.
As my position rose, my salary and allowances went up too.
I get bonuses too, and my treatment has improved a lot.

lines.learner: 불황 때 동료들이 해고되어 걱정이 컸습니다.
lines.en: During the recession, coworkers were laid off, so I was very worried.
lines.roman: bulhwang ttae dongnyodeuri haegodoeeo geokjeongi keotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Do you see this company as a lifelong workplace?
lines.learner: 네, 회사가 직원을 아껴서 오래 다니고 싶습니다.
lines.en: Yes, the company cares about its staff, so I want to stay long.
lines.roman: ne, hoesaga jigwoneul akkyeoseo orae danigo sipseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Is there any work you would like to take on in the future?
lines.en: I would like to try handling overseas sales.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. We'll review it carefully.
lines.en: Thank you. I'll keep working hard.
